rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when the unwanted result is presented as something feared.

example.english: I leave early, lest I get stuck in traffic.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 ging1 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the meaning is mainly to avoid an unwanted result or inconvenience.

example.english: I’m taking a taxi home, lest I get stuck in traffic later.
example.traditional: 我搭的士返屋企，費事一陣塞車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 dik1 si6 faan1 uk1 kei2 fai3 si6 jat1 zan2 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this more formal or written choice for an explicit preventive ‘lest’ clause.

example.english: Please back up the files, lest the computer suddenly break down.
example.traditional: 請將文件備份，免得電腦突然壞咗。
example.jyutping: cing2 zoeng1 man4 gin6 bei6 fan6 min5 dak1 din6 nou5 dat6 jin4 waai6 zo2
